items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And we looked that up in Benny Aslin's (PHONETIC) discography, and we found out that that date was June 16th, 1937, and it was a date with Barney Bigard, Harry Carney, Rex Stewart, Juan Tizol, Duke Ellington, Freddie Guy, Billy Taylor and Sonny Greer.

ctx.x: Well, I was pressed into service, more or less in an emergency, because they wanted more Latin sounds, I was pressed into service as a maraca player on one of the small band, Ellington band dates, under Barney Bigard's name, which I believe was -- I think the tune was "Moonlight Fiesta".

And we looked that up in Benny Aslin's (PHONETIC) discography, and we found out that that date was June 16th, 1937, and it was a date with Barney Bigard, Harry Carney, Rex Stewart, Juan Tizol, Duke Ellington, Freddie Guy, Billy Taylor and Sonny Greer.
